### Open Mic Night @ NCF Cultural Co-op, Ballina

![Open Mic Night](open-mic-feb.jpg)

**Saturday February 21st** /
**From 9pm** (sign-up 9pm, performances from 10pm)

Open mic night returns to the NCF! Whether it's music, poetry, comedy, or storytelling, the stage is open for you. Sign-up begins at 9PM, and performances start at 10PM. Guitars (right- and left-handed) will be available. The evening will be hosted by Seán Gorman and Joe Clarke — come along for a relaxed night of creativity, fun, and community spirit.
